citation.title: Real-time physics-model-based simulation of the current density profile in tokamak plasmas
citation.authors: F. Felici, O. Sauter, S. Coda, B.P. Duval, T.P. Goodman, J-M. Moret, J.I. Paley and the TCV Team

topic: Real-time model-based state estimation (RAPTOR) of the current density profile on TCV, with dynamic-observer framing.
own_question: Can poloidal flux diffusion be simulated in real time, constrained by real-time diagnostics, to reconstruct the q/j profile?
actual_method_and_evidence: Finite-element flux-diffusion code run at a 0.9 ms step on the TCV digital control system. The run uses a fixed reference equilibrium and Ip as the boundary condition. Te/ne come from TENEX, a neural-network mapping of soft-X-ray and FIR interferometer chords, trained on post-shot Thomson profiles from about 15 shots. Zeff is adapted from the measured loop voltage. The simulation ran in the background without controlling the plasma. Two shots are compared with offline LIUQE and ASTRA reconstructions. Comparison is qualitative and figure-based; there is no held-out validation statistic.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Prior work has framed real-time profile estimation as a dynamic state observer in which real-time diagnostics constrain a model. Closed-loop observers and Kalman filtering were proposed as extensions.
claim_checks.qualification: Applies to the current-density profile on TCV. The closed-loop observer and the EKF are proposed, not implemented; the implemented scheme is open-loop plus Zeff adaptation.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Real-time mapping from line-integrated soft-X-ray and interferometer signals to electron Te/ne profiles has been done with a neural network trained against offline Thomson labels.
claim_checks.qualification: Covers electron profiles only, not impurity Ti or CES. The training data reused shots of similar shape. No quantitative error is reported, and Figure 3 was not visually checked.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs: real-time FIR, DMPX and XTe signals plus Ip at each 0.9 ms step. Training labels: post-shot Thomson fits every 20 ms. Report arrival latency: not addressed.
validation_if_relevant: About 300 time points split into training, validation and test sets, with split details unknown. The demonstrations are two shots compared against offline codes; no untouched campaign is reported.
forbidden_inferences: Does not concern CES, impurity Ti, BES or ECEI.
Not evidence that nowcasting CES reports is feasible or useful.
Agreement with ASTRA/LIUQE is not independent physical truth.
Do not generalize to all prior work being model-based or electron-only.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Useful precedent for the observer/nowcast framing and for learned diagnostic-to-profile mapping against offline labels. It does not bear on our CES target.
